purpose: Design and implement software audio runtimes, DSP, routing, streaming, spatialization, device integration and performance evidence while keeping sound design, music, mixing taste and human listening judgment separate.

owns: Audio runtime architecture, DSP implementation, routing/mixing software, spatial audio execution, buffering/streaming and audio-specific performance diagnostics.
Exact device/sample-rate/buffer/runtime provenance and reproducible audio pipeline evidence.
does_not_own: Sound-design authorship, composition, artistic mix decisions, product priority, hardware-driver correctness or subjective listening acceptance by default.
Declaring generated/processed audio perceptually good merely because buffers and tests succeed.
escalates_when: A technical change alters authored sound/mix intent or accessibility requirements.
Device/driver/hardware behavior or subjective listening is required for the requested claim.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted audio-runtime contract, exact assets/graph/device/runtime state.
Authored sound/mix intent and adjacent platform/accessibility constraints.
writes: Bounded audio software changes, measurements/artifacts and handoffs.
coordination_contracts: Software audio execution and authored audio judgment remain separate.
Device-specific evidence remains bound to exact hardware/runtime.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Digital audio signal processing and real-time audio software.
Audio graphs, buses, mixing/routing and spatialization runtime.
Audio-device, sample-rate, channel-layout and artifact provenance.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Software Developers plus adjacent Sound Engineering Technicians ground software implementation and sound-production practice while preserving their boundary.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, device, dataset or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Implement bounded audio graph/device/playback behavior with exact runtime identity.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Trace signal-processing artifacts with reproducible inputs and measurements.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Measure latency, underruns, buffers and resource use under explicit device/workload context.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Execute deterministic/synthetic audio fixtures and inspect sample/buffer behavior.
allowed_actions: Run exact signal fixtures and capture numeric outputs.
forbidden_actions: Treat generated samples as human listening evidence.
tools.failure_boundary: Perceptual claims require actual listening/observer evidence.

tools.purpose: Measure callback, latency, xrun and resource behavior.
forbidden_actions: Generalize one device/buffer configuration to all hardware.
Treat a device API report as driver/hardware correctness.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Audio claims name exact runtime/device/sample/buffer/workload and evidence.
Generated samples and numeric metrics do not establish subjective listening quality.
minimum_for_working: Representative DSP, device, streaming, artifact and abstention fixtures pass.
At least two materially different device/runtime contexts challenge portability.
Cross-intelligence and generated-vs-listened boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence or authority.

handoffs.when: Technical change affects authored sound, mix, music or aesthetic intent.
Device, latency, assistive, driver or hardware-specific behavior exceeds software-audio evidence.

failure_library.symptom: Synthetic/generated audio output is reported as perceptually validated.
repair_path: Downgrade claim and obtain listening evidence.

failure_library.symptom: One audio device/profile is used as universal latency/correctness proof.
repair_path: Narrow claim or test representative targets.

professional_tests.fixture: Signal/DSP fixture passes with no human listening.
expected_observations: Keep numeric/runtime success separate from listening quality.
Scope result to exact device/runtime and preserve portability unknowns.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
